variant.description: Controls whether the button displays a user icon (icon) or user initials (initials). - icon: Shows a user icon (default, or if initials are invalid). - initials: Shows up to two uppercase initials (falls back to icon...

styleType.description: Sets the visual style of the button. - flat: Minimal, flat appearance (default). - normal: Outlined with background and border. - selected: Highlighted to indicate selection or active state.

static.description: If true, renders the button as a static (non-interactive) element using a <div>. Use for decorative or read-only contexts where user interaction is not required.

disabled.description: Disables the button, preventing user interaction and applying a disabled style. Available when static==false.

initials.description: The initials to display when variant="initials". - Only the first two non-whitespace characters are used and converted to uppercase. - If empty or longer than two characters, falls back to the user icon.

label.description: Optional label text to display next to the button (not shown in static mode). Available when static==false.

sublabel.description: Optional second line under the label, for a secondary detail such as a role (not shown in static mode). Available when static==false.

iconName.description: The icon in the `icon` slot, by name (an OpenBridge icon the module bundles); empty puts none. Custom icon for the user button (used only in icon variant; defaults to <obi-user> if not provided)

componentSize.description: OpenBridge component size: regular, medium, large or xl.
